title: Graphic Design and Branding
description:
I have extensive experience in graphic design for projects in different fields. Design and digital editing have always been essential in my work, as they are fundamental for the presentation of any creative project. I have made interfaces, branding, advertising flyers, cards, posters and publications for networks.

I work with Photoshop and Illustrator, tools in which I have great fluency. I am meticulous with the composition, always looking for visual harmony, clarity and balance between shapes, spaces and colors, combining logic and aesthetics in each design.
